title: Farashin aikinku, kare odar ku, kuma ku nuna gwanintar ku

say: Farashin aikinku, kare odar ku, kuma ku nuna gwanintar ku.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 4 na Babban Tailoring da Samfura.

Yawancin ƙwararrun ƙwararrun tela suna samun ƙasa da abin da ya kamata, saboda suna farashi ta hanyar zato. Kyakkyawan farashi yana rufe abubuwa hudu. Na farko, kayan. Ko da abokin ciniki ya kawo yadin da aka saka, kuna siyan lilin, zips, zaren da kuma shiga tsakani.

card.title: Farashin rigar yadin da aka saka

say: Lining, zip, thread, interfacing and boning sun zo kusan naira 8,600.

card.title: Farashin rigar yadin da aka saka

say: Tana son Naira 250,000 duk wata tana dinka kusan awa 125 a wata. Naira 2,000 kenan a awa daya. Rigar tana ɗaukar sa'o'i 10, gami da daidaita ƙirar ƙira da kayan aiki guda biyu. Naira 20,000 kenan.

card.title: Farashin rigar yadin da aka saka

say: Kudinta na wata-wata Naira 130,000, an raba sama da riguna kusan 40. Naira 3,250 kenan kowace riga.

card.title: Farashin rigar yadin da aka saka

say: Jimlar kudinta ya kai naira 31,850. Da ribar kashi 25 cikin 100, ta samu kimanin naira 40,000.
Yanzu ta san cewa cajin 25,000 yana nufin asarar kuɗi akan kowace riga.

card.title: Farashin rigar yadin da aka saka

say: Tufafin kashewa ɗaya yana ɗaukar kusan awanni 10 na aiki, gami da awanni 3 na aikin ƙirar kawai don abokin ciniki.

panel.heading: Gown na kashe daya ko rigar rukuni?
right: Tsarin da aka raba: 0.4 hours kowane

say: A cikin rukunin aso-ebi na mutum 20, ana ba da ƙididdiga na tushe guda ɗaya kuma ana raba su, kuma kuna yankewa kuna ɗinka cikin batches. Aiki yana raguwa zuwa kusan awanni 5.4 a rigar. Don haka kuna iya bayar da ƙaramin farashi, amma kawai bayan ƙididdige shi.
Saita ranar yankewa don aunawa da adibas, da ƙin odar da za ta tura ku bayan taron.
